_notes.visa_address: Raw socket on port 5025 (fastest), or TCPIP0::<ip>::inst0::INSTR for VXI-11.
_notes.channel_coupling: Sent as :CHANnel<N>:INPut. DC | DC50 | AC | LFR1 | LFR2. DSA91204A front end is 50 ohm only.
_notes.channel_scale_v: Vertical scale in V/div (8 divisions -> full window = 8 x scale).
_notes.amplitude_window_v: Total vertical window in V, sent directly as :CHANnel<N>:RANGe. If set (non-null), overrides channel_scale_v.
_notes.acquire_points: Memory depth via :ACQuire:POINts. 0/null = AUTO; timebase range is set to points/rate when both are given.
_notes.trigger_source: e.g. 'CHANnel2'. null = leave the scope's current trigger source.
_notes.force_trigger: true = :TRIGger:SWEep AUTO (self-triggers without signal); false = triggered sweep, :DIGitize waits for a real edge.
_notes.autoscale: false recommended: autoscale fights the explicit vertical/sample-rate configuration.
